title: AI SQL Permission Guard
description: Intercepts out-of-permission SQL that Agents generate: never rewrites SQL silently, refuses execution and returns a structured permission reason the model can act on.

section.title: AI SQL Permission Guard
section.intro: Every database MCP call an Agent makes passes through this policy gate. Violations are refused with a structured reason; the SQL itself is never rewritten.

field.securityMode.blacklist: Blacklist (default) — allow anything a policy does not forbid
field.securityMode.whitelist_emulate: Whitelist emulation — allow only what the policy center grants
field.enableStrictGuardMode.hint: Uses DSH's monotonic ctx.tools.guard(). A refusal holds regardless of plugin load order, closing the last plugin-layer bypass path. Off by default; production deployments turn it on.
field.enableAntiUnmount.hint: Refuses profile operations that would unload this plugin. Off by default so the plugin stays freely removable.
field.enableBundleRequireLock.hint: Fails plugin activation when a declared required bundle is absent. Off by default.
field.sqlParamKeys.hint: Tool-argument keys whose string value is treated as SQL. A candidate that does not parse as SQL is ignored.
field.includeNonMcpSqlTools: Also inspect tools outside those prefixes
field.remotePolicy.enabled: Fetch policy from the permission center
